about_the_game:
As a lord, you are responsible for supporting the Han Dynasty, which is not an easy task. You need to recruit talented people and recruit capable and resourceful retainers. From resourceful counselors to brave and fearless generals, each retainer has unique skills and stories, waiting to work hand in hand with you to achieve hegemony. On this magnificent stage of the Three Kingdoms, you will jointly formulate strategies, fight in all directions, shed blood for the revival of the Han Dynasty, and write your glorious chapter.

At the same time, the game also presents you with a series of romantic and charming emotional stories. In the years of war, you will have the opportunity to meet many beautiful women. They are either gentle and soft, or heroic and valiant, each with their own style. Meeting and knowing the beautiful women and spending a good night together will make the iron-blooded battlefield of the Three Kingdoms more tender and sweet. As the relationship heats up, you can also enter the palace of marriage with your favorite beauty, nurture the crystallization of love together, harvest a unique warmth and happiness in the troubled times, and gradually reach the peak of life.

The features of the game are even more eye-catching. The 80 carefully designed female generals, each with a unique two-dimensional style image and skill setting, whether it is a cold and beautiful sister or a sweet loli, can meet the collection preferences of different players. Collecting these female generals can not only enrich your lineup, but also unlock exclusive plots and skill effects, and enjoy full collection fun.

In the game, those sexy beauties will accompany you through countless romantic nights. They will chat with you, solve your worries, and give you the most gentle comfort in addition to the exciting battles, allowing you to feel a different kind of romance and warmth.

In this feast of hegemony in the Three Kingdoms, who can stand out, who can truly support the Han Dynasty and become the master of this troubled time? The answer is waiting for you to reveal. Come join this two-dimensional simulation business game with the theme of the Three Kingdoms and start your own legendary journey of the Three Kingdoms!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains adult-only pornographic content, sexual acts, and clear depictions of genitalia, so please choose with caution.
